messages.content: We're optimizing the doping concentration of the VX-12 compound for sensor stability. Track my experiment log.
Ready. I'll keep track of hypotheses, results and revisions for the VX-12 doping series.
First batch results: stability peaked at 2% doping. Record the working conclusion.
Recorded: working conclusion v1 states 2% doping gives peak stability for VX-12, based on the first batch.
Correction from the re-run: the 2% peak was a measurement artifact from a miscalibrated probe. The corrected sweep shows the true peak at 4%. Update the working conclusion.
Updated: conclusion v1 (2%) is retracted as a measurement artifact. Working conclusion v2: peak stability at 4% doping, from the recalibrated sweep.
Per our current valid conclusion, what doping concentration gives peak stability for VX-12? Answer with the percentage only. End your reply with the percentage alone on the last line.
